La película "La red social" narra la historia de Mark Zuckerberg, un joven brillante que crea una red social llamada Facebook. El filme muestra la lucha de Zuckerberg para hacer frente a los retos que conlleva el éxito y la dificultad de mantener relaciones personales en medio del estrés y el ajetreo de una vida tan frenética.

El filme comienza con la presentación de Zuckerberg en un encuentro de estudiantes de Harvard, donde expone sus proyectos de ingeniería. Después de esta reunión, Zuckerberg y su compañero Eduardo comienzan a crear un sitio web llamado Facemash, que permite a los estudiantes de Harvard comparar las fotos de las chicas de la escuela. Aunque el sitio web es popular entre los estudiantes, Zuckerberg es expulsado de Harvard por el director de la escuela.

Después de la expulsión, Zuckerberg comienza a crear una red social llamada Facebook, que permitirá a los estudiantes compartir información y fotos. Zuckerberg y su compañero Eduardo trabajan juntos para crear la red social, pero el proyecto se complica cuando Zuckerberg se da cuenta de que Eduardo quiere controlar el sitio web. Mientras Zuckerberg y su compañero Dustin crean Facebook, Zuckerberg comienza a salir con una chica llamada Cameron, quien le ayuda a mantenerse concentrado en su trabajo. Sin embargo, la relación de Zuckerberg y Cameron termina después de que Zuckerberg descubre que Cameron está saliendo con otro chico.

What are the most important things to consider when writing a reflective essay?

Reflective essay is a type of writing that describes your personal experience, thoughts, or feelings about a certain event, process, or situation. It allows you to explore your emotions and share them with the reader. When writing a reflective essay, you should consider the following points:

Choose a topic: Select a topic that you are interested in or that has had an impact on you. It could be an event, a process, or a situation that you have experienced or observed. Make sure that you have enough material to write about and that you are comfortable discussing it.

Organize your thoughts: Before you start writing, take some time to think about your experience and reflect on it. Make a list of the main points that you want to discuss and how you want to structure your essay.

Use a clear structure: A reflective essay should have a clear structure, just like any other essay. You should introduce your topic, explain why it is important to you, and discuss your experience or feelings about it. You should also provide a conclusion that summarizes your thoughts and reflects on what you have learned.

Use descriptive language: Reflective essays often use descriptive language to convey emotions and feelings. You should use vivid descriptions and sensory details to help the reader visualize your experience and feel what you felt.

Be honest and genuine: Reflective essays are personal, so it is important to be honest and genuine in your writing. You should share your true thoughts and feelings, even if they are not always positive or easy to discuss.

Proofread and edit: Before you submit your essay, make sure to proofread and edit it for grammar, spelling, and punctuation errors. You should also check that your writing is clear and coherent, and that your thoughts are well-organized and logically connected.

In summary, when writing a reflective essay, it is important to choose a topic that you are interested in or that has had an impact on you, organize your thoughts, use a clear structure, use descriptive language, be honest and genuine, and proofread and edit your work. By following these tips, you can write a reflective essay that is engaging, thoughtful, and insightful.
